name: GqaSparseFwd
reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import json
import os
SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE = 128


def run(q, kv_cache, topk_idx, block_table, cu_seqlens_q, seq_lens, prefix_lens, sm_scale):
    total_q, H, D = q.shape
    KH = kv_cache.shape[1]
    BS = SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE
    G = H // KH
    topk = topk_idx.shape[-1]
    B = cu_seqlens_q.numel() - 1
    cu = cu_seqlens_q.tolist()
    o = torch.zeros(total_q, H, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
    arange_bs = torch.arange(BS, device=q.device)
    for b in range(B):
        qs, qe = (cu[b], cu[b + 1])
        seq_len = int(seq_lens[b].item())
        prefix = int(prefix_lens[b].item())
        for j in range(qe - qs):
            q_abs = prefix + j
            valid_blocks = (q_abs + BS) // BS
            real_topk = min(topk, valid_blocks)
            if real_topk <= 0:
                continue
            for kh in range(KH):
                blks = topk_idx[kh, qs + j, :real_topk].long()
                pages = block_table[b, blks].long()
                kv = kv_cache[pages, kh].float()
                k = kv[..., :D].reshape(-1, D)
                v = kv[..., D:].reshape(-1, D)
                pos = (blks[:, None] * BS + arange_bs[None, :]).reshape(-1)
                mask = (pos < seq_len) & (pos <= q_abs)
                if not bool(mask.any()):
                    continue
                q_g = q[qs + j, kh * G:(kh + 1) * G].float()
                logits = q_g @ k.t() * sm_scale
                logits = logits.masked_fill(~mask[None, :], float('-inf'))
                o[qs + j, kh * G:(kh + 1) * G] = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1) @ v
    return o.to(q.dtype)
